questions.question: Who is the Ministry official in pink who becomes Hogwarts High Inquisitor?
questions.note: Senior Undersecretary to the Minister. Cat plates, a little cough, and a smile that does not reach her eyes.

questions.question: What sentence does Harry write in detention until it is cut into the back of his hand?
questions.note: Umbridge's quill uses his own blood. There is no ink.

questions.question: What do Harry and his friends name their secret Defense group?
questions.note: They practice because Umbridge will not teach real Defense. The name is meant to scare the Ministry.

questions.question: What room at Hogwarts appears only when someone needs it, and becomes whatever they need?
questions.note: Dobby tells Harry about it. The D.A. trains there. The film calls it the Room of Requirement.

questions.question: What creatures pull the Hogwarts carriages and can be seen only by people who have seen death?
questions.note: Harry can see them after Cedric dies. Luna can see them too, and she is the one who explains.

questions.question: What is the address of the Order of the Phoenix headquarters?
questions.note: The Black family house, hidden in a London square. Sirius is stuck inside and cannot leave.

questions.question: What does Snape try to teach Harry so Voldemort cannot keep entering his mind?
questions.note: Occlumency closes the mind. Legilimency is the art of entering one. Harry sees Snape's worst memory instead of learning the shield.

questions.question: Who kills Sirius Black?
questions.note: In the Department of Mysteries. The curse knocks him through the veil in the Death Chamber.

questions.question: What is the prophecy's line about Harry and Voldemort?
questions.answer: Neither can live while the other survives
choices: Neither can live while the other survives
Both must die before the war can end
The Dark Lord will fall by his own curse
Only a brother's wand can save the boy
questions.note: The orb is smashed in the Hall of Prophecy. Dumbledore is the one who tells Harry what it said.

questions.question: In the film, who tells Umbridge about Dumbledore's Army?
questions.note: Umbridge doses her with Veritaserum. In the book it is Cho's friend Marietta, cursed by a signed parchment, not Cho.
